basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying resilient, low-latency distributed backend systems and microservices, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and security. Proven expertise in real-time systems, data modeling, API design, and full-lifecycle service ownership. Passionate about quality engineering, performance optimization, and driving developer efficiency.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented high-throughput, Python-based distributed microservices, processing 10M+ daily events with a focus on low-latency and resilience.
Standardized reliable containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows, ensuring scalability and operational excellence.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, establishing robust code styling and quality engineering standards, contributing to maintainable and scalable software.
Developed custom internal toolchains that reduced CI pipeline execution times by 40%, significantly improving developer efficiency and velocity.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust and well-designed REST APIs in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, defining critical data models and service interfaces.
Integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors for external developer platforms, focusing on resilient and secure data exchange.
Implemented a comprehensive suite of unit and integration tests, raising coverage from 60% to 92%, enhancing system reliability and correctness.
